planner_input.description: Autonomous smoke and assertion validations suite

project_analysis.summary: LEETCODE is a platform for coding interview preparation, featuring user accounts, problem sets, and solutions.
project_analysis.main_purpose: To provide users with resources to prepare for coding interviews.

smoke_tests: Verify user can register with valid credentials
Verify user can login with valid credentials
Verify navigation to problem sets page
regression_tests: User submits a solution and receives feedback
Problem set filters work as expected
boundary_tests: Register/login with edge cases (e.g., max username length, special characters)
Submit solutions with boundary conditions (e.g., minimum/maximum code length)
negative_tests: Attempt to register with invalid credentials
Attempt to login with incorrect credentials
accessibility_tests: Check for compliance with WCAG 2.1 standards
Ensure all forms and navigation elements are accessible
integration_tests: Verify API endpoints for user registration/login
Verify API endpoints for problem sets and solutions
system_tests: System performance under load (e.g., 100 users simultaneously accessing the platform)
ui_tests: Check visual consistency across different pages
Ensure UI elements are responsive on various devices
functional_tests: Verify functionality of problem set filters and search
Verify solution submission and feedback mechanism
exploratory_tests: Explore user interaction with advanced features (e.g., discussion forums, leaderboards)
compatibility_tests: Test on multiple browsers and devices
performance_test_suggestions: Load test with 100 users simultaneously accessing the platform
api_test_suggestions: Test API endpoints for user registration/login
Test API endpoints for problem sets and solutions

detected_modules.name: User Accounts
detected_modules.purpose: Handles user registration, login, and profile management.

detected_modules.name: Problem Sets
detected_modules.purpose: Provides a collection of coding problems for users to solve.

detected_modules.name: Solutions
detected_modules.purpose: Handles user submissions and provides feedback on solutions.

functional_requirements: Users can register with valid credentials
Users can login with valid credentials
Problem sets are accessible and filterable
Solutions can be submitted and reviewed
non_functional_requirements: System should handle up to 100 users simultaneously
UI should be responsive on various devices

duplicate_data: Duplicate solutions for the same problem
